**Finding submitted: missing (critical) — no indemnification clause exists.**

- Confirmed absence across the whole document: the outline runs from Section 19 (Warranties) straight to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability); searches for "indemnify / hold harmless / defend" and for infringement-claim language returned no operative clause, only orphaned references (9.3 → "Section 20.5" remedies; 19.4 "indemnified claims"; 19.5 "indemnity"; 21.3 "indemnification obligations" as Excluded Claims; 30.5 "indemnified party").
- Target level: **preferred**. Fallback would import a 3× annual-fee super-cap, which is worse for us than the existing uncapped treatment of indemnification obligations under Section 21.3.
- Single surgical insert of a new Section 20 after 19.5 carrying only the ten preferred elements: Vendor defence/indemnity of Customer and Affiliates for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; notice, control of defence, reasonable cooperation; Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
- Noted (not flagged): Section 9.3's cross-reference to "Section 20.5" remedies remains pre-existingly unmatched; procure/modify/replace/refund remedies can be added if Vendor wants that reference honoured.
